## Summary

Describe the problem and the chosen solution.

## Validation

List the commands and representative inputs used to verify the change.

## Compatibility checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] Public API or option changes are documented.
- [ ] Portable behavior changes update `spec/` and `fixtures/`.
- [ ] The change does not introduce image decoding, encoding, file, or network behavior into core.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog entries are updated when user-visible behavior changes.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or confidential images are included.
